_doc: Declared-intent ledger for advisory gates (E4 ceremony detector, M15b #1943/#1949). Every runWarnCheck call site in scripts/check-all.mjs, AND every `class: 'gh-audit'` guard in scripts/lib/anti-fake-green-guards.mjs (whose exit 1 is advisory unless the aggregate runs --enforce, #2419 AC-3), MUST have an entry here: either a dated promotion (promoteBy) or permanent:true with rationale. This is the dated-debt discipline of suppressions expiry (INV-31) applied to the gate roster itself — an advisory gate with no dated promotion is ceremony ('advisory-forever'). scripts/check-bypass-ceremony.mjs (#1949) enforces this ledger, itself a HARD L1 check since #2419 AC-2. The 2 pre-existing runWarnCheck gates 'orchestrator coverage (#1410)' and 'conformance' were resolved by owner decision OD-14 (2026-07-17): dated promoteBy 2026-10-14, same window as the seeded #1943 entries — neither is permanent.

entries.rationale: M8 core substrate + M12 citation enforcement. Advisory until the dispatch cross-check sidecar is routinely populated; promote to runCheck + --enforce at gated-review once producer lines land in ship.md.
#2358 dispatch artifact and vendor-provenance audit. Advisory while cross-model review remains opt-in and local evidence accumulates; promote only after enabled-run coverage is routine.
M13 refutation-by-majority. Advisory until the refutation skill is exercised on real audit findings; promote at gated-review for Standard-tier audits.
M14 dry-pass termination. Advisory until the codebase-audit skill writes the pass-ledger; promote at gated-review where the ledger is part of the audited evidence bundle.
M1 handoff-lint. Advisory at land-time (M1 is a cost rule, all tiers); promote to runCheck once the producer side (/ship handoff phase) references --file mode.

OD-14 (2026-07-17): pre-existing advisory gate, classified dated-promotion (not permanent) — same promoteBy window as the seeded #1943 enforcer entries. Promote to runCheck once orchestrator coverage is routinely satisfied.

OD-14 (2026-07-17): pre-existing advisory gate, classified dated-promotion (not permanent) — same promoteBy window as the seeded #1943 enforcer entries. Promote to runCheck once the conformance surface has a stable pass baseline.

#2079 (F-SSOT-05a): first mechanical proxy for INV-70 (reuse-before-new). Advisory during the start-warn bake-in; the hard flip + core-vs-extended promotion are #2044 item (c), which is blocked on bake-in across the dogfooding consumer repos. Same promoteBy window as the seeded #1943/OD-14 entries.

#2419 AC-3: `class: 'gh-audit'` member of the anti-fake-green roster. The aggregate runs HARD, but a gh-audit guard's exit 1 is ADVISORY — only `--enforce` makes it fail — so it is a second population of advisory gates that the runWarnCheck scan could not see. Advisory while the gh review-window signal accumulates across merged PRs; promote by flipping the aggregate to --enforce for the gh-audit class.
